task: Human code-issue diagnosis with observed source citations, not patch-resolution scoring
selection: Exclude every repository in SWE-bench_Lite dev at 6ec7bb89b9342f664a54a6e0a6ea6501d3437cc2: its public viewer exposed solution excerpts during benchmark research. From remaining train repositories, take first three by SHA256 repo-name ordering and first issue in each by SHA256 instance-ID ordering. Metadata-only selection, no patch/test/hints fields loaded by preparation or actor. Keep all chosen tasks and any preparation/runtime failures.
sources: Original base_commit GitHub archives, complete regular-file contents including original ignore rules; no post-issue patches in the search roots. Archive and source inventories hashed. Symlinks excluded with explicit inventory; no query/label-based pruning. Searches retain actual source budgets and ignore traversal. Downloaded data/source remain ignored.
actor: One existing restoration assistant, label-blind during three tasks. Only actual Ixos search/grep/read for solutions, no web/source grep/direct reads. Original issue text is given. Combined session/code profile, bounded evidence, actual pinned code model, native cache. At most16retrieval calls and18000CLIstdout tokens/task. Freeze diagnoses/citations before loading solution or test fields. Model/agent pretraining familiarity and previous repo familiarity unknown.
submission: Diagnosis, proposed change, uncertainty and observed source citations. Sources remain unedited. Citations must be fully displayed by their referenced call. Original patch/test inspected only after all three submissions frozen; do not retroactively change diagnoses or count overlap with changed files as bug resolution.
metrics: Initial/cumulative/cited localization against later revealed original patch file/hunk locations, exact citation validity, actual calls/stdout/request/diagnostic/ready token costs and descriptive timing. Human qualitative diagnosis comparison explicitly exploratory. No claim of SWE-bench percentage resolved, independent agent accuracy or matched product comparison without applying submitted patches and executing controlled tests.
next: Use misses to design measured evidence/session experiments, reserve official dev/test or new untouched material for later selection. This three-repository train pilot cannot promote defaults or establish leaderboard superiority.
